notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Slumbering Keepguard triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Repeat from step 2.
